  Programming in C sharp [CSE-4307]  
  Marks: 50                                                                             Duration: 180 mins.  
  PART-A  
  Answer all the questions.  
  1)           With a neat diagram explain common language runtime.  
  (3)  
  A)  
  B)      Apply your coding knowledge to resolve scope clash and with an example program  
  show how the new variable named j that we declare in the Main() method hides the          (3)

  C)      Explain advantages of managed code in detail.                                             (4)  
  2)           Illustrate the concept of break in a C# program.  
  (2)  
  A)  
  B)      What is enumeration? Illustrate this concept with C# program to show how values are  
  assigned for months in a year.                                                            (5)  
  
  C)      Demonstrate interface inheritance through a C# program and show how a class is  
  inheriting only one interface.                                                            (3)  
  
  3)           Illustrate how binary operators (-) inside a class Complex can be overloaded in a C#  
  program.  
  (3)  
  A)  
  B)      Choose "addnum" and "subnum" as two delegate names in C# program and show how  
  two values are added and subtracted by invoking delegates.                                (4)  
  
  C)      Consider C# reflection and use typeof operator to get assembly of variable t using the  
  Assembly property                                                                         (3)  
  
  4)           Demonstrate GC.GetGeneration() Method and GC.GetTotalMemory() Method through  
  C# program.  
  (3)  
  A)  
  B)      Consider Dictionary < TKey, TValue> class and demonstrate adding key/value pairs in       (5)
